body.statement: Yao et al. (2025), Assumption D.1 and Corollary D.1, obtain elementwise identification from one single-node intervention per node after assuming that the intervention targets are supplied in a topological order; the accompanying remark treats recovery of that order as a separate subproblem.

source.locator: Assumption D.1, Corollary D.1, and the immediately following remark
source.verbatim_statement: Assumption D.1 (Topologically ordered interventional targets). We assume there are exactly N environments {k₁, …, k_N} where each node j ∈ [N] undergoes one imperfect intervention in environment k_j. The interventional targets 1 ⪯ · · · ⪯ N preserve the topological order. We believe that identifying the topological order is another subproblem orthogonal to identifying the latent variables. Corollary D.1 (Identifiability from single node imperfect intervention per node). Given N environments satisfying Asm. D.1, the ground truth latent variables z can be identified up to element-wise diffeomorphism by combining both marginal and score invariances under our framework.

attestation.note: Main verified arXiv 2409.02772v2 at Assumption D.1, its immediately following remark, and Corollary D.1 on 2026-09-06; transcription combines the exact scope and conclusion sentences with notation normalized from PDF extraction.
